name: @nthplusio/skills
description: A skills.sh pack — reusable skills for AI coding agents.

scripts.check:host-manifests: node node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-code/cli-wrapper.cjs plugin validate . && node node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-code/cli-wrapper.cjs plugin validate dist/plugins/nthplusio-coding-agent && node node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-code/cli-wrapper.cjs plugin validate dist/plugins/nthplusio-conversation
scripts.test:browser: command -v agent-browser && BR_BROWSER_TEST=1 python3 -B -m unittest discover -s skills/scoussens-skills/business-rules-catalogue/evals -p test_explorer.py -v
scripts.test:doorbell: claude plugin validate plugins/doorbell && claude plugin validate plugins/doorbell/skills && claude plugin test plugins/doorbell && node plugins/doorbell/tests/connected-mcp.mjs && tsc -p plugins/doorbell
scripts.test:doorbell-grant: claude plugin validate plugins/doorbell-grant && claude plugin test plugins/doorbell-grant && tsc -p plugins/doorbell-grant
scripts.test:plugins: npm run test:amp-plugins && claude plugin validate . && claude plugin test plugins/context-statusline && npm run test:doorbell && npm run test:doorbell-grant
